blocks.heading: Investment Banking and Capital Markets AI

New York's banks face the most rigorous model risk management requirements of any US financial institutions.

Fixed income and derivatives pricing: ML for bond pricing, yield curve modeling, credit default swap pricing, and derivatives valuation in New York's world-leading fixed income and derivatives markets.

Corporate action processing: ML for event-driven trading and corporate action analytics — earnings release prediction, M&A announcement impact modeling, and regulatory event response for New York's large event-driven hedge fund community.
Cost: $70,000–$190,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | SR 11-7, CCAR, OCC

Cost: $70,000–$185,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | SEC/FINRA context

sections.title: New York FinTech AI Regulatory Context

blocks.heading: OCC and Federal Reserve model risk
paragraphs: New York's nationally-chartered banks operate under the most rigorous model risk supervision in the US — SR 11-7 model validation, CCAR stress testing, and OCC model risk examinations require documentation standards that ClickMasters delivers as standard for NYC bank ML.

blocks.heading: NYDFS (New York Department of Financial Services)

blocks.heading: SEC's AI-related rulemaking
paragraphs: The SEC has been active on AI-related guidance for investment advisers and broker-dealers — ClickMasters designs NYC investment AI with evolving SEC AI frameworks.

blocks.heading: NYC Local Law 144
paragraphs: Automated employment decision tools in NYC require bias audits — ClickMasters designs NYC FinTech employment AI with LL 144 compliance.
